summary: Defines a Capabilities optional parameter for BGP-4 so peers can advertise supported features in the OPEN message. Before this, an unrecognized optional parameter forced a BGP speaker to end peering. It replaces RFC 2842 and was replaced by RFC 5492.

eli5.summary: When two routers meet, they can list what tricks they know. Now an unfamiliar trick no longer ends the conversation, and new features are easier to add.

questions: how do bgp peers negotiate features
